name: PTR character copy: an unreadable source schema reports that copies are not configured
contract: When CoA.PtrCopy.SourceDatabase names a schema this realm cannot read (a misspelt name or a missing SELECT grant), .ptr list and .ptr copy are refused with 'not configured on this realm' and the reason is logged, instead of reporting that the account has no such character on the source realm (live PTR: coa_character_rexxar for coa_characters_rexxar).

steps.label: Copying the player's own character is refused
DISCRIMINATING: the refusal says copies are not configured
DISCRIMINATING: no missing-character message hides the configuration error
